evals.prompt: My Remotion reel looks great on desktop but when I open it on my phone in Chrome's desktop mode, everything is way too small. The component is at src/components/english-reels/NeoBrutalismReel.tsx. Can you scale it up for mobile? Keep the captions as-is though, they're fine.
evals.expected_output: All visual elements (fonts, borders, shadows, padding, gaps, margins, SVG sizes, container dimensions, absolute positions) multiplied by 1.5x. Caption bar untouched. Caption overlap detection added with CAPTION_OVERLAP_RANGES and isCaptionOverlappingVisuals function.

evals.prompt: I have a Remotion component that uses neo-brutalist design with chunky borders and box shadows. It's designed for a 1080x1920 canvas but looks tiny on mobile. The file is at src/components/english-reels/NeoBrutalismReel.tsx. Scale everything up by 1.5x but don't touch the caption bar at the bottom.
evals.expected_output: Systematic 1.5x scaling of all visual properties. Caption bar at bottom:400px remains unchanged. Overlap detection function added to hide captions when scene content extends into the caption zone.

evals.prompt: Scale the Remotion video component at src/components/english-reels/NeoBrutalismReel.tsx for mobile viewing. Multiply all element sizes by 1.5. Keep subtitles at original size. Also make sure the subtitles don't overlap with the visual content — hide them when they would collide.
evals.expected_output: 1.5x scaling applied to all visual elements. Subtitle/caption bar unchanged. CAPTION_OVERLAP_RANGES array defined with frame ranges where content overlaps the bottom caption area. isCaptionOverlappingVisuals function checks current frame against ranges. Caption rendering condition includes !isCaptionOverlapping check.
